replacements.zh: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。

before.literal: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.
before.idiomatic: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.

after.literal: That year, Emperor Cheng sent the yezhe Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, and Duke of Liaodong; with credentials, overall command, and authority to make appointments under imperial mandate, just as in Hui’s precedent.
after.idiomatic: That year Emperor Cheng sent the envoys Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others with credentials to invest Huang as General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with credentials, overall command, and authority to enfeoff by mandate, as Hui had held.

replacements.reason: Idiomatic omits 遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節 and collapses 持節、都督、承制封拜; literal mistranslates 謁者 as “attendants.”

replacements.zh: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。

before.literal: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
before.idiomatic: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.

after.literal: Thereupon he executed the guardians and magistrates Ren had installed, moved the great clans of Liaodong in groups to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
after.idiomatic: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and marched home.

replacements.reason: Idiomatic omits the county names 和陽、武次、西樂; literal lacks an explicit subject for 斬 and is slightly stiffened for parallel use.
